# Research Plan Checklist (requirements + guiding questions ONLY)
Students write every word of the plan. Use the SEFH Student Research Plan Template.

## a. Rationale
- [ ] What problem, why it matters, what's been done, what gap you fill (cited)

## b. Research question(s), hypothesis(es), engineering goal(s), expected outcomes
- [ ] Question in your own words
- [ ] Testable hypothesis: what is compared, how measured, what you expect
- [ ] Engineering goals with measurable targets
- [ ] What a negative result would look like

## c. Detailed sections
- [ ] Materials: hardware, software + versions, data sources
- [ ] Procedures: every phase, repeatable detail, data sources, optional phases labeled
      optional, your steps vs. any supervising adult's steps, how AI tools are used
- [ ] Risk and safety: computational (none/public data); phantoms if listed (risks,
      supervision, precautions, disposal, SDS reviewed)
- [ ] Data analysis: metrics, seeds, CI, statistical test, decision criteria

## d. Acknowledgements
- [ ] People + contributions; AI use with prompt log reference (prompts/, AI_USAGE.md)

## e. Bibliography
- [ ] Major references, found and verified by you (no AI-generated citations)

## Red flags to avoid
- Vague procedures | missing optional phases | no validation | start date before
  signatures | unread or nonexistent sources | AI-sounding text
